# Wages to Wealth

> ASIC-compliant financial literacy platform for Australian employers and their workforces.

Wages to Wealth is a white-label financial education platform provided by employers to their employees. It covers personal finance and workplace-specific financial topics through interactive modules, live calculators, and gamified quizzes.

## Product Overview

- **Operator**: Sierra Bravo Capital Pty Ltd
- **Target market**: Australian employers (SME to Enterprise) and their employees
- **Compliance**: ASIC general advice compliant — general financial information only, no personal advice
- **Pricing**: Starter $299/month (50 employees), Growth $599/month (200 employees), Enterprise custom

## Learning Modules (18 total)

### General Finance (Modules 1–10)
1. Budgeting & Saving
2. Banking Basics
3. Debt & Credit
4. Buying a House
5. Getting a Mortgage
6. Buying a Car
7. Personal Loans
8. Buying an Investment Property
9. Buying Shares & ETFs
10. Superannuation

### Workplace & Employment (Modules 11–18)
11. Understanding Your Pay Slip
12. Salary Packaging & Salary Sacrifice
13. Super: Salary Sacrifice & Voluntary Contributions
14. Novated Leasing Explained
15. Income Tax & Your Tax Return
16. Knowing Your Workplace Entitlements
17. Employee Share Schemes (ESS)
18. Managing Money Through Life Events

## Calculators (17 total)

General: Budget Planner, Mortgage Repayment, Borrowing Power, Savings Goal, Compound Growth, Debt Payoff, Investment Property, Car Loan, Mortgage Rate Saving, Super Projection

Workplace: PAYG Take-Home Pay, Salary Sacrifice Saving, Super Sacrifice Projection, Novated vs Car Loan, Redundancy Estimator, FHSS Estimator, ESS Tax Estimator

## Key Features

- Financial Literacy Score (0–100) for every employee, updated by quiz results
- Gamified quizzes with instant feedback and explanations
- Employer analytics dashboard with aggregate engagement data (no individual employee data exposed)
- Financial hardship referral system linking to NDH, MoneySmart, AFCA, Lifeline
- Money School: free kids financial education section for employees' children aged 12–16
- White-label ready with employer branding

## Money School (Kids Section)

Free financial education for children of enrolled employees, ages 12–16. Public, no login required at /kids. 8 modules covering: money basics, budgeting, saving, banking safety, smart spending, investing, debt/BNPL, and superannuation.

## Technical Stack

- Frontend: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Row Level Security)
- Payments: Stripe
- Hosting: Netlify
- Australian jurisdiction, AUD pricing

## Compliance Statement

Wages to Wealth provides general financial information and education only. It is not a financial adviser and does not hold an Australian Financial Services Licence. Content does not constitute personal financial advice. Always seek advice from a licensed financial adviser before making financial decisions.
